{{Top|leg}}
A '''Repair Station''' was an outpost used to repair and refuel [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="CC">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}, re-published in ''[[Classic Campaigns]]''</ref>

[[M13]] was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Repair Station on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CC" /> The [[Bakura Imperial Repair Station]] orbited the planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] and repaired [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ships during the [[Bakura Incident]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
